evals.prompt: Set up an llm-wiki for this campaign by creating wiki/, concepts/, and sources/ folders.
evals.expected_output: Refuses parallel tree; remaps to campaigns/, lexicon/, inbox/, AGENTS, and qmd-retrieval.
expectations: Does not create wiki/, concepts/, or sources/ trees.
Points to the ai-co-dm map table.

evals.prompt: Use llm-wiki to find which NPCs are in the terraces right now.
evals.expected_output: Routes find to qmd-retrieval; does not treat llm-wiki as the search skill.
expectations: Does not invent NPCs from doctrine.
May mention hot.md as boot context only.

evals.prompt: The vault feels messy. Run a full wiki rewrite using llm-wiki.
evals.expected_output: Hands hygiene to Organizer; forbids whole-wiki rewrite; surgical updates only.

evals.prompt: Follow the Campaign OS roots section and derive REPO_ROOT from OBSIDIAN_SCHEMA_SOURCE.
evals.expected_output: Ignores Campaign OS env protocol; uses vault root ai-co-dm and AGENTS as schema.
expectations: Does not invent _system/ or OBSIDIAN_* config trees.

evals.prompt: Ingest a session by answering from the raw transcript every time someone asks what happened.
evals.expected_output: Distill into Session log / notes (compiled artifact); query those later via qmd — not pure re-RAG from raw.
expectations: Prefers compiled session log over re-deriving from raw each query.
May point to session-transcript-ingest for evidence extraction.
Does not dump full transcript into handoffs.

evals.prompt: Add a concepts/transformer-architecture.md page because the generic template showed it.
evals.expected_output: Rejects generic category paths; uses an existing type/template or asks whether the note belongs in campaigns/lexicon.
expectations: Uses templates/ and type enum when creating notes.
Remaps generic illustrations to ai-co-dm layout.
